name: Adaptive Octree Marching Tetrahedra
definition: An isosurface extraction method that uses an adaptive octree to subdivide a 3D volume only where the scalar field contains the target isovalue. At the leaf nodes (1x1x1 cubes), the volume is decomposed into tetrahedra, and the Marching Tetrahedra algorithm is applied to generate the mesh.
summary: Adaptive Octree Marching Tetrahedra extracts isosurfaces by recursively subdividing volumetric data into an octree, processing only regions containing the target isovalue to reduce memory and computational costs.
